component.name: Jastrzab
component.summary: Share your location with a link, using your own Hauk server

description.p: Jastrzab shares your live location for a time you choose. Anyone with the link sees you on a map in their browser; nobody needs an app or an account. Your position goes to your own Hauk server, not to a company.

ul.li: Share just your own location, or create or join a group share with a PIN
See whether the phone has a GPS fix and how good it is, before and while sharing
Optional end-to-end encryption, so the server only stores scrambled positions
Stop from the notification, even from the lock screen
Built for phones: it fits the screen, sends little data, and wakes the phone as rarely as it can

description.p: Jastrzab is a client for the Hauk location sharing server and is compatible with its Android app's protocol.

ul.li: Preferences: text entries are kept when you leave them or close the window; the apply buttons are gone.
A new share lasts two hours by default.
